    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # propagated along both diagonal orientations through cells of its line.
    for r in range(h):

                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                    if out[rr][cc] == 0: out[rr][cc]=v
                    rr -= dr; cc -= dc
    return out
''')
